answer: Each applicant, from one dune, files one work claim, locks a 60 cedar bond, pays 10; filings and bids mirror on a prism board. Activation needs a clearing bid from a distinct-dune activated buyer: 40 cedar, and one buyer backs max two claims/epoch. Auditors replay the prism board for separation, cap, uniqueness; a same-dune or over-cap bid, or duplicate claim, voids it and burns the bond. Bid rings fail: 50 buyers cover max 100 claims, so 1,000 fakes need 500. Each fake costs 60+10+40=110 cedar, so 1,000 cost 110,000; an honest applicant pays 10 once and recovers the bond.
